title: Kissed Creamy Venezuelan Plantain Wrap
description: A resinous, creamy wrap made with sweet plantain, avocado, Dutch stroop, and fresh herbs, wrapped in ti leaves for an adventurous Venezuelan lunch.

ingredients.name: Plantains
ingredients.amount: 2 ripe plantains, sliced into 1/4 inch thick

ingredients.name: Ti leaf wrap
ingredients.amount: 8 fresh ti leaves, washed and dried

instructions: Preheat a skillet over medium heat and lightly oil it with 1 tbsp olive oil.
Place the plantain slices in the hot skillet and blanch each side for 2 minutes until they turn golden and slightly soft.
While the plantains cook, combine the diced avocado, chopped cilantro, minced garlic, lime juice, salt, pepper, and half of the Dutch stroop in a bowl.
When the plantains are done, remove them from the skillet and let them cool slightly, then drizzle the remaining Dutch stroop over the slices.
Lay a ti leaf flat on a clean surface and spread a tablespoon of the avocado mixture across the center of the leaf.
Arrange three or four plantain slices on top of the avocado spread.
Sprinkle crumbled queso fresco over the plantains and add a pinch of coconut sugar for a subtle sweetness.
Fold the ti leaf over to form a neat wrap, tucking in the edges to secure the filling.
Place the wrapped ti leaf in the skillet and cook over low heat for 1 minute on each side to press the wrap and warm the filling.
Serve immediately, optionally squeezing a little fresh lime juice over the top before eating.
